Class MemoryConnection

java.lang.Object
cn.hutool.db.ds.pooled.ConnectionWraper
io.github.jinghui70.rainbow.dbaccess.memory.MemoryConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, Connection, Wrapper
public class MemoryConnection extends cn.hutool.db.ds.pooled.ConnectionWraper
内存数据库连接

基于H2内存数据库的连接封装，close方法被重写为空操作以保持连接持久
